metadata_caption: Grilled Cheese & Tomato Soup Recipe🧀🍅 Asking people if I could cook them one meal, what would it be?!  Fire Escape Chronicles Pt. 17 🧯 Recipe below 👇🏽  #grilledcheese #grilled #cheese  #cheesepull #bacon #gruyere #cheddar #pepperjack #Tomato #soup #tomatosoup #creamytomatosoup #bisque #souprecipe  #tomatobisquesoup #tomatobisque #recipe #recipies #comfortfood #Comfortmeals #veganrecipes #plantbased #sanMarzano  Tomato Soup:  1. Peeled Tomatoes from San Marzano Can  2. 1 Bell Pepper  3. 1 White onion  4. 1 whole garlic  5. Olive Oil  6. Salt + pepper  7. 1 tbsp sugar  8. 1 tbsp garlic  9. 1/4- 1/2 cup of heavy cream  10. 1-2 tbsp butter  11. 1 tsp Parsley flakes  12. 1 tsp chili  13. Squeeze of lemon  Bacon Jam:  1. 5 slices of bacon cut to small pieces  2. 1 white onion  3. 2 shallots  4. 2 garlic minced  5. 1/2 cup of brown sugar  6. 1/3 cup of maple syrup  7. 1/3 cup of apple cider vinegar  Grilled Cheese  1. Gruyere  2. Cheddar  3. Pepper Jack  4. 3 pieces of bacon  Mayo Sauce  1. 4 tbsp of mayo  2. Fresh herbs 1/2 tbsp  3. 1/2 tbsp garlic powder  ————DIRECTIONS—————  Directions | Tomato Soup:  1. Add Tomatoes, bell pepper, onion, garlic wrapped in tin foil into a tray. Season with olive oil and salt+pepper  2. Put it into a 400 F oven for about 40 minutes or until vegetables have a char to it.  3. Take out the vegetables from the oven and blend by adding in Heavy Cream.  4. Put it onto the stove and add in sugar, butter, parsley flakes, chili, and lemon. You can add more heavy cream here if you need. Directions | Bacon Jam:  1. Cook bacon down and remove and leave bacon fat.  2. Cook onions and shallots for about 15 minutes 3. Add in garlic, brown sugar, maple syrup, bacon, and apple cider vinegar  4. Simmer for about 5 minutes and set aside.  Directions | Grilled Cheese:  1. Lather Mayo sauce on both sides and place on a low flame, hot pan 2. Place bacon jam on both inside sides and top with cheese and bacon.  3. Close and continue to flip till token brown
